overview: The series finds retired librarian Gail, her sister Joy who suffers from early-stage dementia, and old friends Dee and Charlie setting off for a fun filled holiday meant to be Joy's bucket list trip. But when tragedy strikes in the idyllic holiday town, the police are quick to call it an accident. However, the group are convinced it is murder and set out to prove it. The friends dive into their own investigation with the help of Joy's daughter Kate soon crossing paths with DI Simon Lund. As old crimes surface and dark patterns emerge, the group of friends finds that this seemingly idyllic resort town – with its beach walks, pub lunches, and good-natured bickering - hides something far more sinister. Together they must piece together one devastating mystery and track down a killer who has been hunting in this close–knit coastal community and beyond.
title: Last Resort

overview: Experience the breathtaking diversity, resilience, and vibrant colors of the animal kingdom. From majestic lions and soaring peregrines to mysterious manta rays and gentle manatees, explore a world brimming with extraordinary species. Life in the Animal Kingdom unveils the interconnected wonders of nature, showcasing the beauty and ingenuity of its inhabitants. Embark on a captivating journey into their lives and uncover the secrets that make our natural world so remarkable.
title: Life in the Animal Kingdom

overview: You Deserve to Know follows three suburban couples — next-door neighbors and best friends. When one of their husbands is murdered, a shocking trail of secrets is revealed, and their friendship cracks wide open.
title: You Deserve to Know

overview: Charlie Rose is an American television interview show, with Charlie Rose as executive producer, executive editor, and host. The show airs on PBS and is owned by Charlie Rose, Inc. Rose interviews thinkers, writers, politicians, athletes, entertainers, businesspersons, leaders, scientists, and fellow newsmakers. The show premiered on September 30, 1991. In 2010 Rose and cohost Eric Kandel began "The Brain Series", episodes featuring neuroscientists and other experts; the series was later released on DVD. In October 2014, a segment called "Al Hunt on the story" was launched as a "regular feature interview"; Hunt's first interview under this banner was with Secretary of State John Kerry. The show is filmed at 731 Lexington Avenue in Manhattan, New York City. This is the same building which houses Bloomberg Television, and Bloomberg L.P. which sponsors the show.
title: Charlie Rose

overview: Mayama, an ordinary student, receives a love letter from the boy sitting behind him. It turns out to be from Asamiya, the most popular and handsome boy in the class.
title: Seat Change Love

overview: The lives of Luna Arteaga and Maya become intertwined in a story of secrets, betrayal, and second chances. Luna, a young music student in Los Angeles, returns to Mexico when her father's illness and a crisis at the family estate force her to confront a past built on lies. Unbeknownst to her, the source of the turmoil is Dalila Mondragón, the woman she has always believed to be her mother. Meanwhile, Maya is determined to rebuild her life after escaping an abusive marriage. With the support of Sebastián, a doctor who restores her hope, she begins to dream of a new future. But threats from her ex-husband and long-buried secrets threaten to destroy her happiness. When a devastating truth comes to light, both women will find themselves caught in a battle over identity, love, and a disputed inheritance that will change their lives forever.
title: El Renacer de Luna

overview: Sofía Peralta-Avitia runs her family's powerful business empire while trapped in an unhappymarriage to Gonzalo Balmori-Ricci, a serial cheater obsessed with a much younger woman namedGrecia. Her life takes an unexpected turn when Franco Gallardo, a humble man from thecountryside, becomes her bodyguard. What begins as a professional relationship soon blossomsinto a love strong enough to challenge Gonzalo's ambition, jealousy, and desire for control.Meanwhile, Sofía's daughter, Bárbara "Barbi," finds love with her new bodyguard, Salvador "Chava"Reyes, a man haunted by a troubled past. But prejudice, family secrets, and long-standing rivalriesthreaten to tear them apart. Amid deception, passion, and family conflict, Sofía and Franco will discover that finding happinessmay require risking everything.
title: Guardián de Mi Vida

overview: MVD Captain Aglaia Mezentseva and investigator Vsevolod Kosinsky, one of the best specialists in child abduction cases, are unraveling the case of the missing 5-year-old grandson of world-renowned conductor Mark Kretchetov. The child mysteriously disappeared during a walk with his nanny, and the woman herself was hit on the head and lost her memory. Literally all members of the Kretchetov family fall under suspicion, and Kosinsky spares no one in his pursuit of results. Aglaia disapproves of Kosinsky's methods, but nevertheless becomes his best student. The more Aglaia untangles the web of complex family relationships and financial machinations within the Kretchetov family, the more she has to sacrifice – her peace of mind, her career, the lives and feelings of others. And even put her unborn child at risk.
title: Похищение

overview: Princess Royal Nangong Yao is determined to claim the highest seat of power. Standing in her way is Chu Yuan, the fiercely loyal general who serves faithfully at the Crown Prince's side. After countless confrontations, Nangong Yao comes to admire the depth of Chu Yuan's loyalty and becomes determined to win him over, making him acknowledge her as his true master. She sets her plans in motion, driving a wedge between him and his allies while carefully molding him to her side. This empire will be mine. And so will he.
title: The Princess's Snare

overview: Years after fate tore them apart, two former lovers unexpectedly cross paths again. As memories of the past collide with lingering feelings and undeniable chemistry, their reunion becomes a tantalizing push and pull of love and longing. Will they finally get the chance to rewrite their long-awaited summer romance?
title: Endless Summers

overview: Keep up with everything that's happening in the world of golf with Golf Central, the game's only live, daily news source. More than just scores, Golf Central delivers in depth analysis, breaking news, and unforgettable highlights. If it happens in golf, it happens on Golf Central.
title: Golf Central

overview: Psychology PhD Lu Xizhou and rising artist Meng Lusha seem like the perfect couple. After a chance encounter on a rainy night, they build their dream life together in England. But the mysterious suicide of a young girl shatters their perfect world. As buried secrets, revenge, and long-held obsessions resurface, their seemingly flawless love begins to unravel.
title: Love You in the Dark

overview: A modern financial prodigy, Li Qingqing, is suddenly transported back to ancient times, where she becomes the wife of General Pan Yang. Hoping for a quiet and peaceful life, she is blindsided three years later when her husband returns home with his mistress, Li Muyan. At the same time, a long hidden family secret comes to light, revealing that Li Muyan is the true daughter of the Li family. Faced with betrayal on every side, Li Qingqing remains calm. Secretly controlling the empire's most powerful intelligence and business network, Wangshi Tower, she deftly resolves the chaos within the household while matching wits with the ruthless Crown Prince. Armed with her modern financial expertise, she reshapes the ancient business world, overcoming one challenge after another with intelligence and wit. Through every scheme and upheaval, she carves out her own extraordinary path to power and redemption.
title: Auspicious Nobles
Di Er Shi Ba Nian Chun

overview: MTP Daily is a public affairs program hosted by Chuck Todd that looks ahead to 2016 election and features the top newsmakers of the day as they analyze and break down the issues facing the U.S. and world leaders.
title: MTP Daily

overview: When unlucky Subbu is assigned to teach sex ed in a hostile village, he must find a way to succeed while avoiding his conservative father's wrath.
title: Super Subbu

overview: The complex story of two people who get involved with a call centre gang and work together to break up a nation-wide scam organisation.
title: Call Me if You Can

overview: Speaking to people from all different walks of life who have witnessed unidentified beings and unexplained phenomena first hand amid a surge in global fascination with extraterrestrial life. Each testimony adds to a bigger picture that asks if so many people are telling the same story, could it be true?
title: We Are Not Alone

overview: Guests from across the country will showcase their seemingly dull, but actually quite interesting, collections, pastimes and passions. Dara and his board must decide who cuts the mild mustard, who is thrilling by mistake, and who earns the ultimate accolade each episode: the Golden Fleece.
title: Dara's Dull Appreciation Society

overview: The Rules of Vacation follows a newly unemployed woman who takes a summer vacation at her late grandmother's villa, only to cross paths with a mysterious caretaker.
title: The Rules of Vacation

overview: Terror on Long Island takes viewers deep into the chilling saga of a string of murders that haunted the Long Island area for over a decade. Throughout the series, viewers will be guided through the intricate details of the investigation, with exclusive access to first-hand testimonies from those directly involved in the case. Retired detectives, FBI agents, and forensic experts will provide insight into the challenges they faced, the breakthroughs that led to Heuermann's arrest, and the lingering questions that remain. The series also includes emotional interviews with the families of the victims, who share their experiences of loss, frustration, and the painful journey toward closure.
title: Terror on Long Island

overview: Forever by Your Side follows 10 mature, single men and women (all over 50 years old) who leave their everyday lives to cohabitate and travel from Dali, China, to Thailand. The show challenges the stereotype that dating shows are only for the young, highlighting their brave, fearless pursuit of romance and companionship later in life.
title: Forever by Your Side

overview: High school students meet for a short-term romantic getaway, striving to make genuine connections and confessions of love within a limited three-day timeframe.
title: I Fell in Love Today

overview: After a high-profile mission goes sideways, Daniel "Hondo" Harrelson is pulled out of forced retirement to lead a last-chance experimental S.W.A.T. unit made up of untested, unpredictable young recruits. Hondo must bridge a generational divide, navigate clashing personalities and turn a squad of outsiders into a team capable of protecting the city — and saving the program that made him who he is.
title: S.W.A.T. Exiles

overview: School Lawyer: Finding the Colors of the Stars centers on Kenji Shiratori, a lawyer who perceives letters and sounds as specific colors and textures. Misunderstood in his youth, he found school to be a murky environment devoid of color. As an adult, he is appointed as the school lawyer at the newly merged, co-ed Hama Solaris Academy High School. He confronts modern youth crises—such as uniform backlash, truancy, and digital privacy—collaborating with school staff and the Astronomy Club to reach heartfelt resolutions.
title: School Lawyer: Finding the Colors of the Stars

overview: My Mother the Car may very well be known as the most notorious short-lived sitcom of all time and it's solely due to it's premise, a talking car. The pilot episode introduces us to the world of Dave Crabtree. Dave is your ordinary family man, married to wife Barbara and they have two children, Randy and Cindy. However, it's when he purchases a 1928 Porter, that he discovers that another family member is living with him, his deceased mother. It seems Dave Crabtree's mother has been reincarnated as the car.
title: My Mother the Car

overview: Fifteen newsworthy celebrities must own their truth in the court of public opinion. Can they control the narrative, or will they be locked out?
title: Lock Upp

overview: Follow the emotional journey of a historic football club caught between the depths of crisis and the heights of hope. Beyond the action on the pitch, this Sky Original explores the cultural heartbeat of the Ruhr region, documenting why the people of Gelsenkirchen live, suffer, and never give up on their club.
title: Schalke - Dein Aufstieg

overview: Infamous for his spectacular bank heists, audacious prison breaks, and courtroom hostage standoffs, Rory Shayne tore through the underworld for decades—then vanished into thin air. Kings of Coke: The Legend of Rory Shayne takes audiences deep inside the legacy of a one‑of‑a‑kind criminal and the modern-day hunt of the underworld legend.
title: Kings of Coke: The Legend of Rory Shayne

overview: An abandoned car is the only clue. Andreas and Marian entered the water before the flood and have been missing ever since. The Fire Department and the local Police are searching for them. The couple drifts into the canyon without knowing where the other is. Injured, they come out on the banks, screaming in vain, while their daughter searches for them. A wild night begins.
title: Αύριο

overview: In Young Americans, as the children of the nation's elite battle it out at Capitol Crest Academy in Washington D.C., their teenage dramas begin to mirror the larger political games of their parents. Amidst the secrets, scandals, and deadly ambitions, a forbidden romance between two students from opposing political families threatens to escalate tensions to a breaking point.
title: Young Americans

overview: The main characters of the series live in one of Moscow's residential areas. Despite their different personalities and views on life, the sisters support each other in all circumstances. Sveta is the eldest sister, an administrator at a supermarket. She is raising a son and dreams of a relationship, while struggling with trust issues towards men. Naive Dasha is the middle sister, who works as a kindergarten teacher and tries to be sensible. Kris is the youngest, a blogger. She runs a channel called "Hi, Sisters," dedicated to female support and self-identity. Despite their differences, the sisters remain close and united, helping each other – even if not always effectively.
title: Хай Систерс

overview: After failing to join the police force, police academy student Yan Mingyu is expelled for participating in underground boxing matches. Under the direction of Economic Crime Investigation Captain Chen Changjie, he is assigned an undercover mission within Tianyao Group, a powerful corporation run by his biological father, Mai Zhongwei. His objective is to investigate the notorious "812" money-laundering case while uncovering the truth behind his mother's death. Yan Mingyu soon learns that many of the hardships he endured were in fact carefully orchestrated tests designed to assess his suitability as an undercover operative. As he gradually earns the trust of Tianyao Group's leadership, he uncovers a sophisticated money-laundering network involving criminal syndicates that funnel illicit funds through high-profile auctions. His successful infiltration eventually allows him to rise through the ranks and take control of the company. On the eve of the final operation, a mole within law enforcement exposes Yan Mingyu's identity. In a desperate attempt to save his son, Mai Zhongwei sacrifices his life but is murdered by Zhang Junsheng. Framed as a criminal and placed on the wanted list, Yan Mingyu watches his teammates suffer devastating injuries. Forced into hiding, Yan Mingyu pretends to defect to the influential official Zhang Zhiyuan while secretly securing control of 1.5 billion yuan in criminal proceeds and the evidence linked to them through cryptocurrency transactions. In the end, through coordinated efforts from both inside and outside the criminal organization, the entire syndicate is brought to justice. Long-buried murder cases are finally solved, Yan Mingyu clears his name, and he ultimately returns to the police force.
title: Operation Dark Gold

overview: Do you know what scares you? You will get to see what scares the living daylights out of average citizens just like you on Scare Tactics, the hit series from the Sci-Fi Channel and the producers of the hidden camera show Spy TV. The series puts a new spin on the hidden camera idea by featuring pranks inspired by science-fiction and horror films. Such pranks feature "victims" in situations involving haunted houses, alien abductions and more. As an added twist, throughout the seasons the different hosts of Scare Tactics take part in many of the show's pranks.
title: Scare Tactics

overview: A series of overlapping stories of the people living in Pompeii and what their lives were like before fire rained down from the sky with the eruption of Mount Vesuvius.
title: Pompeii: A Day of Fire

overview: The live-action adaptation follows best friends Clover, Alex, and Sam as they balance saving the world as spies with the ups and downs of starting college, showcasing their girl power, friendship, and staying true to themselves.
title: Totally Spies!

overview: On Hardball with Chris Matthews, author and veteran journalist Chris Matthews hosts a passionate hour of in-depth political analysis and fiery debate with top politicos and Hollywood icons. Hardball provides inside-the-Beltway access for all through Matthews' unique, entertaining style.
title: Hardball with Chris Matthews

overview: Based on a historical fantasy novel, the series follows a scholar who travels back in time and becomes trapped in a time loop with a legendary knight, forcing them to challenge history and fate itself.
title: The Everlasting

overview: When a 10-year-old boy stumbles upon a terrifying sight, he learns the brutal realities of life, survival and desperation in a town on the edge.
title: No tengo miedo

overview: Martín Salcedo is rarely swept off his feet — until Verónica Pinilla and Quiebra Canto turn up the party, booze and danger.
title: Salcedo, cuero y boogaloo

overview: "LIDA" (Liminal Individual Diagnostic Algorithm) is a Russian AI technology designed to assist psychotherapists in addressing the deep layers of a patient's psyche, accurately identifying the root causes of traumatic conditions and facilitating healing. With the "LIDA" program, the path to recovery is intended to take just a few sessions, rather than years of therapy. The technology is currently in the final stage of clinical research, undergoing trials with volunteers and patients suffering from severe psychological conditions.
title: ЛИДА

overview: Ordinary working mom Yu Bo Na is secretly the legendary assassin Kingfisher, who eliminates criminals beyond the reach of the law. Returning to work after three years of maternity leave, she resumes a perilous double life, balancing work, childcare, housework, and assassinations. As her missions grow more dangerous, a detective hunting a mysterious killer and a husband beginning to suspect the truth threaten to expose her secret. From school drop-offs to taking down criminals, every moment is a high-wire act with no room to slip up. The instant her true identity surfaces, she stands to lose everything. Can Yu Bo Na keep her identity hidden and protect both worlds as a loving wife and mother to her family and a ruthless killer to her targets?
title: A Bona Fide Killer

overview: Two people from different backgrounds escaping their own past and finding a new life in post World War 2 Australia, can their pasts be left behind? Can the war be forgotten?
title: The Far Country

overview: With "Shit Show – Welcome to Reality", RTL+ deconstructs its own formula for success. This new eight-part mockumentary opens up the engine room of a (fictional) dating show—revealing that the real chaos reigns not among the pool of contestants, but behind the camera.
title: Shit Show – Welcome to Reality

overview: The CNN Quiz Show is a series of game show specials where three teams of two CNN anchors each battle it out for a chance at winning $40,000 for their favorite charity in a wild quiz show that test their knowledge of specific trivia. The CNN Quiz Show is hosted by Anderson Cooper. The total prize pool offered on every show is $40,000 and here's how the money is divided: 1st Prize - $20,000 - 2nd Prize - $10,000 - 3rd Prize - $10,000
title: The CNN Quiz Show

overview: In this one-of-a-kind reality competition, lucky players step inside Wonka's Chocolate Factory to face unpredictable games, tests and temptations.
title: Wonka's The Golden Ticket

overview: Years after her mother vanished, Sabina follows a mysterious clue to an uncharted island, where she confronts hidden dark secrets within her own family.
title: Balaraw

overview: Top chefs and restaurateurs from across Korea gather to launch new street food brands in a real-world business survival. From menu creation and pricing to service and turnover, every element of running a restaurant is tested. In a blind street battle where customers don't know the chefs, only sales decide the winner.
title: Street Restaurant Fighter

overview: Szene Report is a comedy series conceived as a mockumentary about subcultures of the past 30 years in Germany. Three episodes show insights into the microcosm of the emo scene, LAN parties and skate punk.
title: Szene Report

overview: A detective in his 40s gets along with everyone except his sharp-tongued younger colleague. But when a proposal to find the detective a match comes up, it ends up changing the relationship between the two.
title: Duty First, Kiss Later

overview: Rob Rinder returns to his roots as a criminal defence barrister to revisit one of the most haunting cases of his career. Twenty years on, Rinder revisits the case, reflecting on the events and examining his own role within them
title: Rob Rinder: The Crime I Can't Forget

overview: In the dark underworld of New Orleans, the Winters family builds an empire around a powerful new drug—crafted from the ashes of the dead—that grants users vivid, haunting visions of the past. But as demand surges, rival factions, deadly secrets, and supernatural forces close in, pulling them deeper into a violent and inescapable nightmare of crime, horror, and family legacy.
title: Bone Parish

overview: International violinist Shi Qi has spent four years emotionally freezing out her husband and neglecting their family because of a painful misunderstanding. Only when the truth begins to surface does she realize that the resentment she held onto may have been aimed at the wrong person all along.
title: Longing For You, Day and Night

overview: CNN Tonight is the title of several news programs that were broadcast by U.S. cable network CNN. The CNN Tonight branding has primarily been used for transitional programs aired by CNN in the evening and prime time hours as part of changes to its programming lineup—including the departure (either voluntary or via termination) or reassignment of anchors.
title: CNN Tonight
Love Remains as Obsessive as Before

overview: Set in 1999, the story centers on Haruka Tada, a Tokyo office worker sent to Taiwan just as a Japanese consortium wins the contract for the high-speed rail. The project triggers memories of her first solo trip to Taiwan as a university student, where she briefly met a local man named Eric. The narrative unfolds across multiple intertwining lives over the course of several years, highlighting the deep cultural and personal bonds between Japan and Taiwan.
title: Ru: Taiwan Express

overview: To save her mother's company, Sang Ruan decides to marry Cheng Wang, the youngest son of the Cheng family. At the same time, she attracts Qin Yan, a top investor returning from overseas, to inject capital into the company to turn the tide. In her well-crafted first encounter, Qin falls in love at first sight, while Cheng also catches feelings for her. However, she is unaware that Qin and Cheng are biological brothers who each took one parent's surname; neither do the two know that they are after the same woman. Sang Xiaosu is the first to discover something amiss and actively exposes it, in hopes of destroying Sang Ruan. Realizing they are brothers, she acknowledges her mistake and expects to face the consequence, only for the brothers to turn against each other to win her heart. With three hearts entangled, which brother will she choose?
title: Tangled Up With Two Brothers
My Twisted Life Finds its Tender Love

overview: In 2011, detective Xu Weizhang discovers the skeleton of an unidentified woman concealed within the ruins of the Scala Nightclub, a victim whose death had remained hidden for sixteen years. During the investigation, he unexpectedly makes contact with police officer Liu Xinjian in 1995, forging a connection that transcends time. Working together across two different eras, the pair advance the investigation from opposite ends of the timeline, exchanging clues and piecing together the truth. Their unprecedented collaboration ultimately leads to the resolution of a serial murder case that had been buried for sixteen years.
title: Reverse Chase

overview: Superbeast is a series that showcases nature's ultimate athletes and apex predators as they survive and dominate in Earth's toughest arenas.
title: Superbeast

overview: Worldwide, The X Factor has created global superstars such as Leona Lewis, One Direction, Cher Lloyd, Olly Murs, Little Mix and Rebecca Ferguson. Artists discovered by "The X Factor" format have sold more than 100 million records worldwide, including 110 No.1, 270 Top 10 and 501 Top 50 releases. Local versions of "The X Factor" are now produced in more than 40 territories and The X Factor (USA) airs in 166 countries.
title: The X Factor

overview: You and Me is a BBC television programme for pre-school children broadcast from 1974 to 1995. It aired on BBC 1 from 1974-1983 & on BBC 2 from 1983-1995. The programmes consisted of various segments intended to educate and entertain young children and included elements for early literacy and numeracy. The first episode, called "Moving house", was broadcast at 10:45 am 14 January 1974 on BBC1. The series' original intention was to teach children safety, reading and emotional well being. The show featured a mixture of human actors and puppets. Originally it featured the actor Tony Hughes as Herbert The Handyman, along with the puppet characters Mr Bits and Pieces and Purrfecta the Cat.
title: You and Me

overview: The Chase Around the World will take contestants on a global adventure competition. This series sees six pairs of contestants attempt to track down the biggest brains in Britain - all six of The Chasers - in undisclosed locations around the globe. Unravelling puzzles along the way, the winning pair will pit their knowledge against The Chasers in order to win a life-changing prize pot.
title: The Chase Around the World

overview: The Surf House is set high on the cliffs of Morocco and is based in a sanctuary for surfers and travellers chasing sunshine and waves. But the idyll hides a dark mystery, and when Bea washes in, seeking refuge after a dangerous encounter in Marrakesh, she soon gets caught in the current. A woman her age – who stayed in the same area, walked the same beaches, met the same guests – disappeared one year earlier, vanishing without trace, and her last known whereabouts was The Surf House.
title: The Surf House

overview: After an unprecedented attack on his elite unit, a high-ranking officer set to leave the field leads a perilous mission that forces him to confront his past.
title: GIGN

overview: Web novelist Xiaowei builds her career writing powerful romances. But in real life, she often ends up being the one getting cheated on. The pressure becomes too much that she decides to go on an exile to Kenting in Southern Taiwan. Xiaowei befriends three Kenting locals - Hanwen, Liangliang and Azuo. She also becomes friends with Anan, a young man who also travels southward to Kenting. The five of them experience struggles, love, losses, pain, self-discoveries and much more. The story also tells of a prominent financial holding company that arbitrarily modifies the development proposal put forth by Chu Yiyang, and goes on land grabbing through Zhong Hanwen, incurring the wrath of the locals.
title: Wayward Kenting

overview: The dynamic between the two contrasting personalities, a seasoned cop who prefers old-school methods and a tech-savvy cop who relies on modern technology for investigations, as they navigate their partnership in solving crimes.
title: Pritam and Pedro
